content.content:
1. Necessity: the prerequisites fix four sides of one landing — the record a landing addresses and the one value that picks it out; the base that record already carries, the owned content it is compared against, and the differences the comparison yields; what a landing does when they disagree and what it names; and what a landing does when they agree, and in what unit. None of them is a model of the landing, so it is unsettled whether a machine holds one landing at once: which record a landing acts on and how that record is found, over what the comparison runs and what it yields, what a refused landing changes, and whether the placement and the record's turn are one step or two. Fail if the model artifact could be dropped without loss.

2. Conformance and fidelity, both directions, applied to the model the dependent's content refs, read against each prerequisite as each is recorded at check time:

a. No looser — every fact a prerequisite fixes about landing is carried by the model: that a landing addresses exactly one record, that the record is the one filed under the handle it is addressed by, and that the handle alone picks it out — not its node, its edit or its workspace; that the base the record already carries is compared, path by path, against the owned set as it stands at the landing, the differing paths being the paths on which the two sides disagree in either direction, including a base entry the owned set no longer holds and an owned path the base does not carry; that a record with differing paths is refused — its landing places nothing and leaves every record as it was — and that the difference is named for that record, its handle together with the paths that differ for it; that the stale test is node-wide: a landing is refused when any open record naming the target node is stale, even when the record the landing addresses is itself fresh, and the refusal names every such stale record by its handle together with the paths that differ for it, so a fresh landing of the addressed record is still refused while an open sibling on the same node is stale, and the naming is every stale handle on that node, not only the addressed one; that a record whose every entry agrees lands, subject to that node-wide test, and that inside that same landing its state becomes the registry's second state while its handle, its references and its base stay as filed and the record is kept; that the landing is the recording it already is, one step, with no registry write bracketed beside it and no record's state written outside it; that a landing addresses one record even when several records name the same node, and that every other record is left untouched by it — untouched being that record's state, references and base, so a sibling is neither moved, rewritten nor removed, whether the addressed record landed or the landing was refused; that the node-wide test fixes which records it tests and what a refusal names, and fixes no order among them and no cap on records; and that the record's only state move is first-state to second-state, so a record already in the second state is not landed again and none is moved back. A fact the model omits, weakens or leaves unconstrained is a loose divergence: name the fact and the prerequisite that fixes it.

b. No stricter — the model requires, forbids or constrains nothing a prerequisite does not fix: no second landing, no second verb or second operation carrying the record's state change, no state, transition or guard beyond the ones the record form fixes, no record element or reference the record form does not carry, no refusal a prerequisite does not state, no fix on which refusal is tested first or on the internal order of the landing's parts, no repair of a record with differing paths (no re-basing, no reopening, no removal), no cap on records, no listing surface, no marker or trunk fact, and no graph effect or storage fact of its own — the landing creates no node, edge or marker, and the document a record is read from, its path, its filename and its encoding are not modelled as part of the landing. Nor does the criterion let the model decide the encoding of the content comparison, or the wording, separators, ordering, stream and exit status of a refusal. Any such element is a strict divergence: name it and the rule it adds.

c. The carried shape — where a prerequisite carries a machine-checkable artifact that fixes the record's form, its state values, its one state move and its landed form, the landing model is read against that artifact and uses it: a fact the artifact fixes and the model contradicts, omits, weakens or restates in its own terms, and a fact the model adds that the artifact does not fix, are divergences, each named in the direction it falls. That shape is the artifact's, read at check time; it is not restated here.

The criterion names no element of the model or of the dependencies in advance: which fact is at issue is found while reading the artifact against the recorded prerequisites, and appears only in the finding. It tracks no wording of the dependent and survives a rewording of the dependent that leaves what it decides unchanged.
content.rationale:
Four edges claim one landing. The dependent is a Quint module — a tool-checkable artifact — so the edges sit on the conformance and fidelity cells: the three requirement sentences (the record a landing addresses and the base it compares, the refusal when a record naming the node has moved, with the handles and paths it names, the landing of a record whose base still agrees and the turn of its state inside it) are structured-to-code, and the record model is code-to-code. The check is necessity plus the same rule read in both directions: the landing model must carry exactly the landing the prerequisites fix, neither looser nor stricter. That is the right gate because what is in question is the transition the artifact states — which records a landing admits, what it reads, and what it writes — and that is read off its actions and their guards, whether or not a run is ever taken. A well-typed action model can still find its record by node, compare only the paths a call names, let a record with differing paths land, or split the placement and the state write into two steps, and each of those diverges in one direction a one-directional check would miss.

It is applied by reading the model against each prerequisite as each is recorded at check time, so it reads whatever the prerequisites land and pins none of their wording: the three requirement sentences are skeletons in this layer and are read as each is authored and landed, and the criterion presupposes no clause their final text must contain. The record's form, its two states, its one move and its landed form are the record model's, read at check time rather than pre-authored here.

One evaluation covers all four edges because they claim one act from four sides and a single pass over the model answers all four; splitting would read the same artifact four times. Nothing runs for the criterion: a Quint typecheck of the model is only the precondition that the artifact parses, and the review is the gate — in this form red is the artifact's absence or, where a model exists, its divergence — the prerequisites' landing unenforced by it until the model carries the fact. The code-to-code edge's cell asks for a runnable check; this unit's write set licenses no check path at all, so that edge is read as a static comparison against the record model and the cell is flagged for a matrix entry. This refinement amends the criterion because the earlier text read the sibling rule as untouchedness alone — one landing names one record even when several name the same node, and every other record is left untouched by it — which a per-record stale model satisfies; uvrltuvo, recorded beneath vmwvnnzv, and ptlmptoy fix a node-wide test instead, so the no-looser direction now also carries the refusal when any open record naming the target node is stale, the naming of every stale handle with the differing paths for it, and the refusal of a fresh addressed record while an open sibling on the same node is stale; the form, the other facts and every exclusion are unchanged.
